title: release-kit project config
description: Per-project bindings for the release-kit plugin (git-release skill, git-commit and git-sync commands). Lives at <repo>/.claude/release-kit.json.

prCli.description: How the release/hotfix PR or MR is opened and merged. 'gh' (GitHub CLI) and 'glab' (GitLab CLI) are automated. 'none' works with any host (Bitbucket, Azure DevOps, Gitea, protected branches): the skill prints the title and body, the user opens and merges the PR/MR in the host UI, and the skill verifies the merge with git before tagging.

remote.description: Name of the git remote every fetch, push and tag targets.

devBranch.description: Integration branch releases are cut from. When omitted, git-commit and git-sync use whichever of 'dev' / 'develop' exists on the remote.

mainBranch.description: Production branch that gets tagged. When omitted, git-commit and git-sync use 'main', falling back to 'master'.

qaBranches.description: Long-lived QA branches (besides release/*). git-commit cuts fix/* branches from them and git-sync rebases those fix/* branches back onto them.

tagPrefix.description: Prefix of release tags, release branches and changelog headings: '<tagPrefix>X.Y.Z'. Use '' for bare tags (MinVer's default). 'vX.Y.Z' in the skill text means '<tagPrefix>X.Y.Z'.

tagAnnotated.description: true creates annotated tags (git tag -a), which 'git describe' and some CI setups require. false creates lightweight tags.

versioningNote.description: One line describing how the version is derived (echoed in summaries). e.g. 'backend via MinVer (git tag); frontend/package.json is not touched'. Omitted from summaries when absent.

versionFiles.description: Files whose version must match the release tag. Each is bumped to X.Y.Z (no prefix) on the release/hotfix branch before the PR/MR, so the tagged commit already carries the version. Empty or omitted = the tag is the only version.

path.description: Repo-relative path to a JSON file with a top-level "version" field (package.json, plugin.json, composer.json, ...).

bumpCmd.description: Optional shell command to bump the file instead of editing the JSON directly. '{version}' is replaced with the numeric version. Run from the directory of 'path'. e.g. 'bun pm version {version} --no-git-tag-version'.

frontendVersionFile.description: DEPRECATED — use versionFiles. Path (repo-relative) to a package.json whose "version" field must be bumped to match the tag. null = nothing to bump.

frontendVersionBumpCmd.description: DEPRECATED — use versionFiles[].bumpCmd. Optional shell command to bump frontendVersionFile; '{version}' is replaced with the numeric version.

gate.description: Verification commands. Run from repo root.

phase1.description: Fail-fast check before cutting the release branch (Standard Phase 1). Defaults to 'mandatory' if omitted.

mandatory.description: The blocking gate: Standard Phase 2, Quick release, and Hotfix. A failure stops the release (no PR/MR, no merge).

changelogPath.description: Repo-relative path to the changelog (Keep a Changelog format). Used by git-release and git-commit.

ciTriggerNote.description: One sentence describing when CI runs, shown in the Phase 2 gate section. e.g. '.github/workflows/release.yml triggers on tag push; CI runs after the tag, there is no PR CI'. Omitted when absent.

modes.description: Enabled workflows. 'standard' and 'hotfix' are the usual pair; add 'quick' to allow dev -> main in one pass. A workflow not listed here is refused.
